purpose: Reuse the Azur Menton ready-text/media pattern for ABVXsite native Writing and Working Stories using existing content-ops approval and consumer commands.

required_inputs.name: approved_source
required_inputs.description: Ready publication-safe prose and explicit metadata

required_inputs.name: consumer_checkout
required_inputs.description: Clean ABVXsite checkout from current main

deterministic_steps.description: Prepare ready Markdown in ABVX OS
Inspect, approve and emit the packet using existing content operations
Run the selected native publisher dry-run, then apply the reviewed packet in the consumer checkout
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: Unique story/media plan; use content:publish-writing for a native note
Passing receipt and generated indexes ready for one PR

deterministic_steps.description: After authorized release verify SHA and actual public routes/media; reuse discovery QA
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: Public checks pass independently from Vercel SHA and Search Console state

STANDARD: One PR with source and intended indexes
FULL: Default build in CI and UI regression evidence for code changes

expected_outputs: Native source and approved media in the consumer checkout
Generated public indexes in the same PR
allowed_changes: Consumer-native content and explicitly referenced approved media via the project command
prohibited_changes: Consumer repository mutation from ABVX OS
New renderer, CMS, scheduler or generic workflow engine
